title: Let customers cancel pending orders
description: Adds POST /api/orders/:id/cancel so customers can cancel an order before it is paid, with tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: The order is looked up by id alone, with no check that it belongs to the signed-in user, so any customer can cancel another customer's order.
Only cancelled orders are refused, so a PAID order can be cancelled too, although only pending orders should be.
